name: ping-when-ready
description: Notify when a Copilot agent asks for input or finishes a response in VS Code.

scripts.package: npm run compile && mkdir -p artifacts && vsce package --out artifacts/$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.vsix

commands.title: Ping When Ready: Choose Sound File
Ping When Ready: Choose Response Sound
Ping When Ready: Choose Question Sound
Ping When Ready: Enable Copilot Notification Hooks
Ping When Ready: Disable Copilot Notification Hooks
Ping When Ready: Send Test iMessage
Ping When Ready: Set iMessage Recipient
Ping When Ready: Test Agent-Stop Notification

pingWhenReady.notifications.macOS.description: Show a native macOS Notification Center banner when a Copilot agent finishes a turn. Check this box to receive system notifications.

pingWhenReady.notifications.sound.description: Play the selected WAV or MP3 sound when a Copilot agent finishes a turn.

pingWhenReady.soundFile.deprecationMessage: Use Response Sound File and Question Sound File. This setting remains as a fallback for both notification types.
pingWhenReady.soundFile.description: Absolute path to a WAV or MP3 notification sound on this Mac.

pingWhenReady.responseSoundFile.description: WAV or MP3 sound file used when an agent finishes a response. Use Ping When Ready: Choose Response Sound to select a file.

pingWhenReady.questionSoundFile.description: WAV or MP3 sound file used when an agent asks a question. Use Ping When Ready: Choose Question Sound to select a file.

pingWhenReady.notifications.iMessage.description: Send an iMessage through the macOS Messages app when a Copilot agent finishes a turn. Check this box to receive iMessages; set the recipient with the Ping When Ready: Set iMessage Recipient command.

pingWhenReady.notifications.includeSumma.description: Include a short local excerpt from the agent's response or question in notifications and iMessages. Disable to use generic notification text only.
